posts.title: Пример документа - Греция
posts.text:
🇬🇷 Example: Greek work approval document 📄

This is what a real document from the Greek authorities looks like 🏛
👉 Decentralised Administration of Attica - approval for seasonal work (loaders and warehouse workers), sent to the Greek Consulate in New Delhi.

⚠️ Be careful! Many fake "agents" show photoshopped papers and take money 💸❌
A real document always has:
✔️ Official government header and protocol number
✔️ Stamp and signature
✔️ The consulate it is sent to

If someone can't show you documents like this - don't pay and don't send your passport 🚫

posts.title: Пример документов - Италия (альбом)
posts.text:
🇮🇹 Example: Italian work authorization documents 📄

1️⃣ Receipt - the employer's application in the Italian Ministry of Interior system
2️⃣ Letter from the Immigration Office (Sportello Unico) - sent to the Italian Embassy in New Delhi, after which the worker applies for the visa 🛂

⚠️ Know what is real:
In Italy the process ALWAYS starts with the employer's application. No application = no work visa. Anyone promising "Italy visa in 2 weeks" without it is lying ❌

posts.title: Пример визы - Польша
posts.text:
🇵🇱 Example: Polish national work visa (type D) 🛂

How to recognise a real one:
✔️ It is a sticker in the passport, not a paper printout
✔️ Type "D" - national visa
✔️ Issued by the Polish consulate
✔️ Purpose of issue ("CEL WYDANIA") printed on it

⚠️ Be careful: a Schengen tourist visa is NOT a work visa. Anyone selling "work on a tourist visa" is putting you at risk ❌

posts.title: Пример контракта - Турция
posts.text:
🇹🇷 Example: what a real Turkish work contract looks like 📑

✔️ Fixed-term employment contract in Turkish + English
✔️ Employer details and SGK (social security) workplace number
✔️ Job title and contract duration clearly written
✔️ Work permit through the Ministry of Labour

⚠️ Be careful: no contract and no work permit = no legal job. Never go to work "on a tourist visa" - you can be deported 🚫

posts.text:

⚠️ Always check: the name and passport number on the visa must match YOUR passport exactly. One mistake - and you will not be allowed to board ✈️❌

posts.title: Как проходит отбор
posts.text:
🔍 How our selection works

1️⃣ You apply with CV + vacancy code 📄
2️⃣ Our team checks your experience and documents 🧐
3️⃣ Shortlist: we contact selected candidates and send a short text questionnaire 📝
4️⃣ The employer confirms ✅
5️⃣ Visa and documents 🛂
6️⃣ Flight and start of work ✈️🏭

⚠️ We can stop the process at any step if something doesn't match. The decision is always ours.

💡 Tip: a clear CV with real experience is the fastest way through step 2.
